intro.title: BarCamp is a COMMUNITY CONFERENCE
content: BarCamp is a user generated conference where the speakers are everyday folks talking about what interests them. Talks aren’t scheduled or planned until just before the conference starts, and anyone can give a talk. Curious, but don’t want to take the stage? That’s okay too.

At BarCamp, you won’t find a predetermined speaker list or a line of suits passing out business cards. What you will find is some shaggy dude in a t-shirt talking about moonshine, a web developer talking about the best practices in SEO, or a world traveler sharing their experiences. BarCamp is a chance to network, learn something new, and share what awakens your curiosity. Come one, come all.

venue.title: The Venue
venue.description: Strengthening the creative culture of the greater Omaha area by providing direct support to local artists and increasing the visibility of contemporary art forms in our community.

tracks.title: The Tracks
tracks.description: Talks are organized into two speaking categories

tracks.name: Entrepreneurs
tracks.description: Marketing Your iOS App, Bird Watching for fun and profit, Competitive Intelligence on a Shoestring, How to get Venture Capital, Fostering a Co-working Environment

tracks.name: Makers
tracks.description: CSS3 and the Future of Design, How to Wrangle WordPress, HTML5 and the Modern Browser, iPhone, Me, and My Drone, Hardware is the New Geocities

events.title: Talk signup begins
events.description: We're doing something slightly unique—we're opening the schedule a whole 24 hours early! Talks are 20 minutes long, within a 3 hour block, AND there are only 2 tracks, both of which will be recorded!

events.title: Doors open
events.description: Grab some lunch and coffee, sign up for a talk, and start the day getting to know your fellow BarCampers.

events.title: Talks Begin
events.description: We’ll start out the first round of talks promptly at 1pm, so make sure you’re all settled in and ready to learn!

events.title: Closing
events.description: Say your goodbyes, collect addresses for your new pen pals, and start looking forward to next year.

faqs.question: What is Silicon Prairie Startup Week?
faqs.answer: It's a week-long celebration of the startup and entrepreneurial community in Nebraska. Learn more!

faqs.question: Is this event free?
faqs.answer: Yes! This event is free to attend, for all folks in the community—not just silicon prairie startup week attendees. Come one, come all!

faqs.question: How long are the talks?
faqs.answer: This format si different - each talk runs for 15 minutes. Speakers are allowed to use that time however they wish—you can even share a time slot with multiple people or set up a panel discussion, allowing time for Q&A at the end. The last 5 minutes of every 20 minute slot is reserved as transition time between talks.

faqs.question: Can I give a sales presentation?
faqs.answer: Nope! To be respectful of our BarCamp community, sales presentations or pitches are not allowed. Don’t even try it, folks.

faqs.question: What should I bring?
faqs.answer: Something to share with all of your new friends…a business card perhaps? We encourage you to bring a notebook for notes. If you’ve planned a talk with presentation slides, bring your laptop or an external drive with your files. And bring all your friends!

faqs.question: What if I have a food allergy?
faqs.answer: No sweat! We make sure everyone is included. If you have specific food allergies or restrictions, contact Will at barcampevents@gmail.com and we’ll take care of you.
